AAPL.claim_supported: Sole global Section 12(b) national securities exchange listing for common stock without secondary or cross-listings.

GOOGL.instrument_title: Class A Common Stock, $0.001 par value
GOOGL.request_locator: Form 10-K Cover Page Section 12(b) Registration Table
GOOGL.section_table_locator: Cover page, Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act: Row 1
GOOGL.temporal_limitations: Establishes Section 12(b) registration as of filing date; multi-class relationship with GOOG (Class C) is documented in the same registration table.
GOOGL.claim_supported: Class A Common Stock is registered under Section 12(b) on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC as its sole exchange listing.
inferences_prohibited: Does not infer that Class A is the exclusive equity listing of the issuer (Class C is concurrently registered).
Does not infer that Class C is a secondary listing without explicit multi-class governance rules.
GOOGL.contract_ambiguity_notes: Alphabet Inc. maintains a multi-class equity structure (Class A voting, Class C non-voting, Class B unlisted). Both Class A and Class C trade natively on Nasdaq. While Class A is the primary voting common stock, contract Rule R06 does not define multi-class equity precedence. primary_listing preserved as None pending explicit multi-class policy qualification.

GOOG.instrument_title: Class C Capital Stock, $0.001 par value
GOOG.request_locator: Form 10-K Cover Page Section 12(b) Registration Table
GOOG.section_table_locator: Cover page, Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act: Row 2
GOOG.temporal_limitations: Establishes Section 12(b) registration as of filing date; non-voting status relative to Class A is defined in corporate charter.
GOOG.claim_supported: Class C Capital Stock is registered under Section 12(b) on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC.
inferences_prohibited: Does not infer that non-voting Class C constitutes a 'secondary listing' under Rule R06.
Does not infer that Class C is equivalent to Class A common voting stock.
GOOG.contract_ambiguity_notes: Rule R06 ('Must be primary listing, not secondary or cross-listing') is ambiguous regarding whether non-voting capital stock (Class C) issued alongside voting common stock (Class A) is considered a secondary listing. Setting True risks admitting secondary classes against original rule intent; setting False treats an authentic exchange listing as a cross-listing. primary_listing preserved as None.

TSM.instrument_title: American Depositary Shares, each representing five Ordinary Shares
TSM.request_locator: Form 20-F Cover Page Section 12(b) Registration Table
TSM.section_table_locator: Cover page, Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act: Row 1
TSM.temporal_limitations: Establishes Section 12(b) registration of the American Depositary Shares on NYSE; underlying ordinary shares trade on Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE: 2330).
TSM.claim_supported: American Depositary Shares are registered under Section 12(b) on the New York Stock Exchange as the primary US trading facility for the ADR.
inferences_prohibited: Does not infer that NYSE is the global primary listing venue for TSMC's underlying ordinary shares (which trade on TWSE).
Does not infer primary_listing=False solely because the issuer is incorporated abroad or because it is an ADR.
TSM.contract_ambiguity_notes: TSMC home market is Taiwan (TWSE: 2330). On NYSE, TSM trades as a Depositary Receipt. Rule R02 already rejects Depositary Receipts from stock VCP. Rule R06 does not define whether an ADR's primary trading venue satisfies 'primary listing' when the underlying ordinary share trades on a foreign primary exchange. primary_listing preserved as None.
